title: Author Terminal Transition and Poison-Pill Tests
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Write physical pytest cases (real SQLite WAL files, real threads; no mock objects): test_ch04_fr_005_* for SRS-412-04-FR-005 (Tasks exceeding 3 failed execution attempts shall automatically transition to terminal `BLOCKED` status.); test_ch04_fr_009_* for SRS-412-04-FR-009 (Any state transition terminating 'RUNNING' status (to 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', or 'BLOCKED') shall explicitly clear `lease_owner = NULL` and `lease_expires_at = NULL` in the same transaction to maintain the Signal ZD-8 invariant.); test_ch04_complete_task_* for INTERFACE:complete_task (complete_task(db_path: str, task_id: int) -> bool. Transition task to COMPLETED and clear lease_owner to maintain Signal ZD-8 invariant.); test_ch04_fail_task_* for INTERFACE:fail_task (fail_task(db_path: str, task_id: int, error_log: str, max_attempts: int = 3) -> bool. Transition failed task to FAILED or BLOCKED, clearing lease_owner for ZD-8 safety.). Section 9 obligations: Test verifies `attempts >= 3` transitions status to `BLOCKED`.
